summary: Read every one of the 34 available Chinese units and checked all 32 temporal/hint items and all 15 people. No numeric dates occur in the source. Legendary qualitative dates are supported. Historical author, petition and signature ranges need focused supplementary evidence for their endpoints and event ownership, especially the eight identical editor windows and Sima Qian's lifespan-like interval. This is a complete research-held audit, not approval or a claim that every proposed year is false. No source or extraction has been altered.

itemChecks.event: Xiao Zixian authors and petitions to compile the Southern Qi history.
itemChecks.reason: The text dates his work to Liang and a petition to Emperor Wu; the later criticism is reception of that work. It supplies no numerical endpoint for AD 502-537 and no death at 537. These bounds require cited supplementary author/reign evidence and must describe uncertainty in the compilation event, not activity throughout the interval.

itemChecks.event: Sima Qian collects earlier material and writes history after the Qin book burning.
itemChecks.reason: The source contrasts an ancient subject matter with the later historian; it gives neither BC 145 nor BC 86. These look like unsourced life endpoints, not dates of compiling the history. The thousands of years phrase concerns earlier legendary rulers, not Sima Qian's own lifespan.

evidence.quote: 兩漢以來爲史者，去之遠矣。
司馬遷從五帝三王旣歿數千載之後，秦火之餘，因散絕殘脫之經，以及傳記百家之說，區區掇拾，以集著其善惡之迹，興廢之端，又創己意以爲本紀、世家、八書、列傳之文，斯亦可謂奇矣。
夫自三代以後爲史者如遷之文，亦不可不謂儁偉拔出之材、非常之士也，然顧以謂明不足以周萬事之理，道不足以適天下之用，智不足以通難知之意，文不足以發難顯之情者，何哉？
蓋聖賢之高致，遷固有不能純達其情而見之於後者矣，故不得而與之也。
遷之得失如此，況其他邪？

司馬遷從五帝三王旣歿數千載之後，秦火之餘，因散絕殘脫之經，以及傳記百家之說，區區掇拾，以集著其善惡之迹，興廢之端，又創己意以爲本紀、世家、八書、列傳之文，斯亦可謂奇矣。
夫自三代以後爲史者如遷之文，亦不可不謂儁偉拔出之材、非常之士也，然顧以謂明不足以周萬事之理，道不足以適天下之用，智不足以通難知之意，文不足以發難顯之情者，何哉？
蓋聖賢之高致，遷固有不能純達其情而見之於後者矣，故不得而與之也。
遷之得失如此，況其他邪？
